Market today: The market's feeling sour, driven by the 10-year Treasury yield hitting 5% and rising oil prices. This is a double whammy for your tech/chip heavy book, as higher rates hurt growth valuations and inflation fears loom. AI stocks are also sliding.

Your holdings: SOXL (-59.44%) and SPAL (-30.34%) are both SELL status, leveraged, and decaying – they need immediate attention. SMH (-14.56%) and QQQ (-0.62%) are TRIM status, facing tech headwinds. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the Fed decision this week and any further developments in AI regulation or sentiment.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your leveraged and underperforming tech positions given the current rate environment and sector headwinds.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL given its SELL status, significant loss, and leveraged decay; review its stop loss.
SPAL is also a SELL, down over 30%; consider reducing exposure to this leveraged ETF.
SMH is a TRIM, down 14.56% and near its stop at 540; watch this level closely.
